label: Docs / help center
summary: Documentation, knowledge base or support site

choices.label: Search is the main entry point

preview_screen: The help center home: search, popular topics, and category cards.
code_target: A docs site in the project's stack (plain HTML, CSS and JS by default) with search, category and article routes, a table of contents and a no-results state.
derive_when_silent: When the brief doesn't describe help content, derive a help-center structure from the product's features and flows: getting started, one article group per main feature, account and billing, troubleshooting, and contact support.
required_screens: Article page with table of contents
design_guidance: Reading comfort first: a line length of about 60-80 characters, generous line height, clear heading hierarchy.
Always show where the reader is (breadcrumbs, highlighted nav, in-page table of contents).
Search results show a snippet and the matched context.

checks: Article body line length is about 60-80 characters and line height is 1.4 or more.
The reader's location is visible (breadcrumbs, nav state, table of contents).
Search has suggestions and a no-results state with a next step.
Code blocks scroll or wrap without clipping and have a copy control.
